title: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer · Practice exam

format.note: The real exam has 50-60 multiple choice and multiple select questions in 2 hours.
format.scoring: Google does not publish the passing score; results are pass/fail. 70% here is an indicative target.

domains.name: Setting up a cloud solution environment
Planning and implementing a cloud solution
Ensuring successful operation of a cloud solution

questions.q: A company is starting on Google Cloud. It wants separate environments for development and production, with different administrators, and central policies applied to everything. Which resource hierarchy is MOST appropriate?
o: An organization node with folders for dev and prod, each containing its projects
A single project containing all environments separated by labels
Separate billing accounts with no organization
One folder per developer containing a shared project
questions.e: Folders group projects so that IAM and organization policies can be applied per environment and inherited by the projects below.

questions.q: Which statement about IAM policy inheritance in the Google Cloud resource hierarchy is correct?
o: Allow policies are inherited downward, and the effective policy of a resource is the union of its own policy and those of its ancestors
A policy on a project overrides and removes roles granted at the folder level
Policies are inherited upward, from projects to the organization
questions.e: Allow policies are additive. To block access granted higher up you need IAM deny policies, not a lower-level allow policy.

questions.q: Security wants to make sure that NO virtual machine in the organization can have an external IP address, including in projects created in the future. What should you do?
o: Set the organization policy constraint that restricts VM external IP access at the organization node
Create a firewall rule in every project that blocks egress
Remove the Compute Admin role from all users
Ask developers to use the --no-address flag
questions.e: Organization policy constraints are inherited by all current and future projects under the node where they are set.

questions.q: Due to data residency rules, resources must only be created in European locations. What is the MOST effective preventive control?
o: An organization policy using the resource locations constraint, restricted to EU locations
A label named region=eu on every resource
A weekly script that deletes non-EU resources
A budget alert for non-EU regions
questions.e: The resource locations constraint prevents the creation of location-based resources outside the allowed list.

questions.q: You run 'gcloud compute instances create' and receive an error saying the Compute Engine API has not been used in the project or is disabled. What should you do?
o: Enable the API with 'gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com'
Grant yourself the Owner role at the organization
Install the compute component of the gcloud CLI
questions.e: Most Google Cloud APIs must be enabled per project before use.

questions.q: An engineer works on three projects every day and keeps creating resources in the wrong one. Which gcloud feature helps the MOST?
o: Named configurations ('gcloud config configurations create' and 'activate'), each with its own project, account, and default region
Editing the ~/.bashrc file to rename projects
questions.e: Named configurations store sets of properties and switching between them is a single command.

questions.q: Which command sets the default project for the active gcloud configuration?
questions.e: Properties of the active configuration are set with 'gcloud config set'.

questions.q: A new project must be able to create resources that cost money. Which roles are needed to link the project to an existing Cloud Billing account?
o: Billing Account User on the billing account, plus Project Billing Manager (or Owner) on the project
Billing Account Viewer on the billing account only
questions.e: Linking needs permission on both sides: the billing account and the project.

questions.q: Finance wants to be notified by email when monthly spend in a project reaches 50%, 90%, and 100% of a target amount. What should you configure?
o: A Cloud Billing budget with threshold rules for that project
A quota limit on the Compute Engine API
questions.e: Budgets send alerts at thresholds. They do not stop spending by themselves.

questions.q: A manager believes that a budget of 1,000 EUR will automatically stop all resources when it is exceeded. What is correct?
o: Budgets only send notifications; to act automatically you must send budget notifications to Pub/Sub and handle them programmatically
Budgets shut down all resources at 100%
questions.e: Programmatic notifications via Pub/Sub can trigger a function that, for example, disables billing; this is a deliberate and disruptive choice.

questions.q: The data team wants to analyze detailed daily costs per service and per label using SQL. What should you set up?
o: A CSV download from the console every month
questions.e: Billing export to BigQuery provides detailed usage and cost data that can be queried and visualized.

questions.q: Developers want to see which team owns which cost in the billing reports. What is the simplest practice?
o: Apply labels such as team and environment to resources and filter or group reports by them
Create a separate billing account per developer
Rename all resources with the team name
questions.e: Labels are key-value pairs that propagate to billing data.

questions.q: A deployment fails because the project has reached the maximum number of CPUs allowed in a region. What should you do?
o: Request a quota increase for that region in the console (IAM & Admin > Quotas)
questions.e: Quotas limit resources per project and region; increases can be requested.

questions.q: Which statement about Google Cloud projects is correct?
o: The project ID is globally unique and cannot be changed after creation, while the project name can be changed
The project name is globally unique and immutable
The project number is chosen by the user
A project can belong to several folders at the same time
questions.e: Project ID is unique and permanent; the display name is editable; the number is assigned by Google.

questions.q: A company already uses an external identity provider for employees. It wants them to sign in to the Google Cloud console with their existing corporate identities, without creating Google accounts. Which feature fits?
o: Service account keys for each employee
questions.e: Workforce Identity Federation lets an external IdP authenticate workforce users for Google Cloud access.

questions.q: Your company manages users and groups for Google Cloud centrally. Which product provides managed Google identities for users who do not need Google Workspace?
questions.e: Cloud Identity is the identity-as-a-service offering that provides users, groups and the organization resource.

questions.q: When granting IAM roles to many people with the same job, which approach is recommended?
o: Grant roles to a Google group and manage membership of the group
Grant roles individually to each user
Share one user account among the team
Give everybody the Owner role and audit later
questions.e: Groups simplify administration and reduce errors.

questions.q: An analyst needs to explore all VM instances and their IAM bindings across 40 projects in the organization. Which service helps search resources and policies across the hierarchy?
questions.e: Cloud Asset Inventory searches and exports resource and IAM policy metadata.

questions.q: A team wants AI assistance in the console to understand an error, design a deployment, and get optimization suggestions about its Google Cloud resources. Which product is designed for this?
questions.e: Gemini Cloud Assist provides AI help across the lifecycle of Google Cloud applications and infrastructure.

questions.q: Which actions are part of the recommended setup of a new organization?
o: Create groups for administrative functions and grant roles to the groups
Configure the organization's billing account and budgets
Give every user the Organization Administrator role
Disable Cloud Audit Logs to save costs
Create all resources in the organization node directly without projects
questions.e: Groups-based administration and billing setup are part of the foundation; resources always live in projects.

questions.q: A small team wants to try commands without installing anything locally. Which environment has the gcloud CLI, kubectl, and Terraform preinstalled and is authenticated with their identity?
o: A Compute Engine VM with a public image
questions.e: Cloud Shell is a browser-based shell with common tools and a persistent home directory.

questions.q: Which free option helps a newcomer estimate the cost of a planned architecture before creating any resource?
questions.e: The pricing calculator estimates costs based on configuration and usage.

questions.q: A legacy application runs on a specific operating system and requires full control of the kernel parameters. Which compute service fits?
questions.e: Compute Engine provides VMs with full OS control (IaaS).

questions.q: A stateless containerized HTTP API has unpredictable traffic, including long periods with no requests. The team does not want to manage servers or clusters. Which service is MOST appropriate?
o: Compute Engine with a managed instance group
questions.e: Cloud Run runs containers serverlessly and can scale to zero.

questions.q: Your team needs Kubernetes but does not want to manage nodes, node pools, or their capacity. Which option fits?
o: GKE Standard with a single node pool
questions.e: In Autopilot, Google manages nodes and you pay for Pod resource requests.

questions.q: A batch job processes images overnight, can be interrupted and restarted at any time, and must be as cheap as possible. Which VM option is BEST?
o: VMs with local SSD and a reservation
questions.e: Spot VMs offer large discounts but can be preempted at any time.

questions.q: An application needs 6 vCPUs and 20 GB of memory, which does not match any predefined machine type well. What can you do?
o: Create a VM with a custom machine type
Always choose a machine with 16 vCPUs
Use two VMs with 3 vCPUs each
questions.e: Custom machine types let you choose vCPUs and memory within the allowed ratios.

questions.q: A web tier on Compute Engine must scale automatically with load and replace unhealthy instances, across zones of a region. What should you create?
o: A regional managed instance group from an instance template, with autoscaling and an autohealing health check
One large VM with a startup script
questions.e: Regional MIGs spread instances across zones; autoscaling and autohealing are MIG features.

questions.q: A licensing agreement requires that your VMs run on physical servers that are not shared with other customers. Which option fits?
questions.e: Sole-tenant nodes are physical servers dedicated to your project.

questions.q: Which storage class is the MOST cost-effective for backups that are kept for years and are read less than once a year?
questions.e: Archive has the lowest storage cost and a 365-day minimum storage duration; access costs are higher.

questions.q: Log files are read often in the first 30 days, rarely after, and must be deleted after 1 year. What should you configure on the bucket?
o: Object Lifecycle Management rules: change the storage class after 30 days and delete after 365 days
questions.e: Lifecycle rules automate class transitions and deletion.

questions.q: Which bucket location type stores data redundantly across two specific regions you choose?
questions.e: Dual-region buckets replicate across a pair of regions.

questions.q: An application needs a managed relational database (PostgreSQL) for a regional workload of moderate size with automatic backups. Which service is the simplest choice?
questions.e: Cloud SQL is managed MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server for typical regional workloads.

questions.q: A global financial application needs a relational database with strong consistency, horizontal scaling, and high availability across continents. Which service fits?
questions.e: Spanner is a globally distributed, strongly consistent relational database.

questions.q: An IoT platform writes millions of time-series measurements per second and needs low-latency reads by row key. Which database fits BEST?
questions.e: Bigtable is a wide-column NoSQL store for high throughput and low latency at scale.

questions.q: A mobile app needs a serverless document database with real-time updates and offline support. Which service fits?
questions.e: Firestore is a serverless NoSQL document database with real-time listeners and offline SDKs.

questions.q: Analysts want to run SQL over terabytes of data without managing infrastructure. Which service fits?
questions.e: BigQuery is a serverless data warehouse.

questions.q: An application needs an in-memory cache to reduce latency of repeated database reads. Which managed service fits?
questions.e: Memorystore provides managed Redis and Valkey/Memcached-compatible caches.

questions.q: Which statement about VPC networks in Google Cloud is correct?
o: A VPC network is a global resource and its subnets are regional
A VPC network is zonal and subnets are global
Each region requires a separate VPC network
questions.e: This is why VMs in different regions of the same VPC can communicate on internal IPs.

questions.q: Your security team requires control over IP ranges and wants subnets only in the regions you use. Which VPC mode should you choose?
questions.e: Custom mode lets you define every subnet and range; auto mode creates one subnet per region.

questions.q: A subnet is running out of IP addresses. What can you do without recreating it?
o: Expand the primary IP range with 'gcloud compute networks subnets expand-ip-range'
Shrink the range and add a new one
Change the VPC to auto mode
Assign external IPs to all VMs
questions.e: Primary ranges can be expanded (not shrunk) if the new range does not overlap others.

questions.q: Several teams have their own projects, but the network team must manage a single network centrally for all of them. Which feature fits?
o: Shared VPC with a host project and service projects
VPC Network Peering between every pair of projects
A separate VPC per project with external IPs
questions.e: Shared VPC lets service projects use subnets of a central host project.

questions.q: VPC A is peered with VPC B, and VPC B is peered with VPC C. Can VMs in A reach VMs in C through B?
o: No, VPC Network Peering is not transitive
Yes, if firewall rules allow it
questions.e: Peering connects two networks only. Use other designs (for example NCC) for hub-and-spoke routing.

questions.q: Private VMs without external IPs must download OS updates from the internet. What should you configure?
o: Cloud NAT on a Cloud Router in that region
External IP addresses on every VM
A VPC peering with the internet
questions.e: Cloud NAT provides outbound internet access for resources without external IPs.

questions.q: VMs without external IPs must reach Cloud Storage and BigQuery APIs. What is the simplest configuration?
o: Enable Private Google Access on the subnet
Create a VPC peering with Cloud Storage
questions.e: Private Google Access lets internal-only VMs reach Google APIs.

questions.q: A global website needs a single anycast IP, HTTPS termination, URL-based routing, and backends in several regions. Which load balancer fits?
o: Regional external passthrough Network Load Balancer
questions.e: The global external Application Load Balancer is a layer 7 proxy with a global anycast IP.

questions.q: A game server uses UDP and needs to preserve the client source IP, with backends in one region. Which load balancer fits?
questions.e: Passthrough Network Load Balancers handle TCP/UDP and preserve the client IP.

questions.q: An on-premises data center needs a private connection to Google Cloud quickly, over the internet, with a 99.99% availability SLA. What should you choose?
o: HA VPN with two tunnels configured as recommended
questions.e: HA VPN offers a 99.99% SLA when configured with redundant tunnels; Interconnect requires provisioning time.

questions.q: A company needs 10 Gbps of private, low-latency connectivity and its data center is in a Google colocation facility. Which option fits?
questions.e: Dedicated Interconnect gives a direct physical connection; Partner Interconnect goes through a provider.

questions.q: Internal applications must resolve names such as db.internal.example only inside the VPC. What should you create?
o: A Cloud DNS private zone visible to the VPC
questions.e: Private zones are visible only to the authorized VPC networks.

questions.q: The team wants to manage Google Cloud infrastructure declaratively, with code reviewed in Git and a plan before every change. What is the most common tool?
o: Bash scripts with gcloud and no state
questions.e: Terraform is Google Cloud's recommended IaC tool; Infrastructure Manager can run it as a managed service.

questions.q: A platform team already uses Kubernetes and wants to manage Cloud SQL instances and Pub/Sub topics as Kubernetes resources. Which tool fits?
questions.e: Config Connector is a Kubernetes add-on that manages Google Cloud resources through custom resources.

questions.q: Which service lets you run Terraform deployments managed by Google, with state stored for you?
questions.e: Infrastructure Manager automates deployment of infrastructure defined with Terraform.

questions.q: Where should you store container images that Cloud Run and GKE will pull?
questions.e: Artifact Registry stores container images and language packages with IAM control.

questions.q: An event-driven function must run every time an object is uploaded to a bucket. Which options can deliver this event?
o: Eventarc triggering a Cloud Run service or function
A Cloud Storage trigger on Cloud Run functions
questions.e: Cloud Run functions use Eventarc for Cloud Storage events.

questions.q: An application must decouple producers and consumers, absorbing traffic spikes asynchronously. Which service fits?
questions.e: Pub/Sub is a managed asynchronous messaging service.

questions.q: You must migrate 300 TB from an on-premises data center with limited bandwidth to Cloud Storage in a few weeks. What is the most practical option?
o: gcloud storage cp over the internet connection
questions.e: Transfer Appliance is a physical device for large offline transfers.

questions.q: You need to copy data from an Amazon S3 bucket to Cloud Storage on a recurring schedule. Which managed service fits?
questions.e: Storage Transfer Service moves data from other clouds, HTTP sources, and file systems.

questions.q: You need to SSH to a VM that has no external IP from your laptop, without a VPN or bastion host. What should you use?
o: Identity-Aware Proxy TCP forwarding, with a firewall rule allowing ingress from 35.235.240.0/20 on port 22
A public IP temporarily for every session
questions.e: IAP TCP forwarding tunnels SSH through Google; the IAP range must be allowed by the firewall.

questions.q: Your company wants SSH access to Linux VMs to be controlled by IAM roles, not by keys copied into metadata. What should you enable?
questions.e: OS Login links Linux accounts to Google identities and IAM roles such as roles/compute.osLogin.

questions.q: You need a daily, automatic backup of a VM's boot disk, kept for 14 days. What should you configure?
o: A snapshot schedule attached to the disk with a 14-day retention
A cron job that copies files to the same disk
questions.e: Snapshot schedules create incremental snapshots and delete old ones automatically.

questions.q: You must roll out a new instance template to a managed instance group gradually, with no reduction in serving capacity. What do you use?
o: A rolling update of the MIG with maxUnavailable 0 and maxSurge greater than 0
Delete the MIG and create it again
Stop all instances and restart them
Change the template of each VM manually
questions.e: Rolling updates replace instances progressively according to surge and unavailability settings.

questions.q: Which command fetches credentials so that kubectl can talk to an existing GKE cluster?
o: gcloud container clusters get-credentials CLUSTER --location LOCATION
questions.e: get-credentials writes a kubeconfig entry for the cluster.

questions.q: On a GKE Standard cluster, a workload needs GPUs while other workloads do not. What should you do?
o: Add a separate node pool with GPU machines and schedule the workload on it
Recreate the whole cluster with GPUs on all nodes
Increase the number of nodes in the default pool
questions.e: Node pools group nodes with the same configuration within a cluster.

questions.q: Pods in a GKE Standard cluster stay Pending because there is not enough capacity. What enables nodes to be added automatically?
o: Cluster autoscaler on the node pool
questions.e: Cluster autoscaler resizes node pools; HPA changes the number of Pods.

questions.q: You deployed revision 'v2' of a Cloud Run service with '--no-traffic'. How do you send 10% of traffic to it?
o: Create a second service and a DNS weight
questions.e: Cloud Run supports gradual rollouts by splitting traffic between revisions.

questions.q: A Cloud Run service has slow first requests after idle periods. What reduces cold starts?
o: Set a minimum number of instances
questions.e: Minimum instances keep containers warm, at an extra cost.

questions.q: Which command uploads a local file to a Cloud Storage bucket with the current CLI?
questions.e: 'gcloud storage' is the recommended CLI for Cloud Storage operations.

questions.q: Users accidentally overwrite and delete objects in a bucket. You want to be able to recover previous versions. What should you enable?
o: Object Versioning (with lifecycle rules to limit the number of noncurrent versions)
questions.e: Versioning keeps noncurrent versions when objects are overwritten or deleted.

questions.q: A partner without a Google account must download one object for the next 2 hours. What is the BEST approach?
o: Generate a signed URL that expires in 2 hours
Create a Google account for the partner and grant Storage Admin
questions.e: Signed URLs grant time-limited access to a specific object.

questions.q: A Cloud SQL for MySQL instance must survive a zone failure with automatic failover. What should you configure?
o: High availability (regional) configuration with a standby in another zone
A read replica in the same zone
Daily exports to Cloud Storage only
questions.e: HA uses synchronous replication to a standby instance in another zone.

questions.q: Read traffic is overwhelming a Cloud SQL primary instance. What helps scale reads?
o: Create read replicas and send read queries to them
questions.e: Read replicas offload read traffic; HA alone does not serve reads.

questions.q: You need to restore a Cloud SQL database to the state it had 10 minutes before a faulty migration. What feature is needed?
o: Point-in-time recovery, enabled before the incident
questions.e: PITR uses logs to restore to a specific moment; it must be enabled beforehand.

questions.q: Before running a BigQuery query, an analyst wants to know how many bytes it will process. What should they use?
questions.e: A dry run validates the query and estimates bytes processed; LIMIT does not reduce scanned bytes in most cases.

questions.q: Which practices reduce BigQuery on-demand query costs?
o: Select only the needed columns instead of SELECT *
Partition tables and filter on the partitioning column
Add LIMIT to every query, since it always reduces bytes scanned
Run queries twice to warm the cache
Store data in CSV instead of tables
questions.e: On-demand pricing is based on bytes processed; columns and partitions matter.

questions.q: A firewall rule allows SSH from 0.0.0.0/0 with priority 1000, and another denies SSH from 0.0.0.0/0 with priority 900. What happens?
o: SSH is denied, because the lower number has higher priority
SSH is allowed, because allow rules win
questions.e: Priority 0 is highest, 65535 lowest.

questions.q: With no custom firewall rules in a new VPC, what is the behavior?
o: Implied rules deny all ingress and allow all egress
All ingress and egress are allowed
questions.e: Every VPC has implied deny-ingress and allow-egress rules at the lowest priority.

questions.q: A firewall rule must apply only to web servers, not all VMs in the network. How should you target it?
o: Use a target network tag or, preferably, a target service account attached to the web servers
Create a separate VPC per VM
questions.e: Targets limit which instances a rule applies to; service accounts are more controlled than tags.

questions.q: A connection to a VM fails and you suspect a firewall issue. Which tools help diagnose it?
o: Connectivity Tests in Network Intelligence Center
questions.e: Connectivity Tests analyze the path; firewall logging shows which rules matched.

questions.q: You need memory utilization and application logs from Compute Engine VMs. What should you install?
questions.e: Memory metrics and guest logs need the Ops Agent.

questions.q: The operations team must be paged when a website does not respond from multiple locations. What should you configure?
o: An uptime check with an alerting policy and a notification channel
questions.e: Uptime checks probe endpoints; alerting policies notify on failure.

questions.q: One team wants to view metrics from 20 projects in a single Cloud Monitoring dashboard. What should they configure?
o: A metrics scope in a scoping project that includes the 20 projects
questions.e: A metrics scope defines which projects' metrics a project can view.

questions.q: Compliance requires that all audit logs of all projects in the organization be stored in a central location, including future projects. What should you create?
o: An aggregated log sink at the organization level with include-children, routed to a central log bucket or BigQuery dataset
A sink in every existing project
questions.e: Aggregated sinks route logs from all child resources.

questions.q: Which audit logs are always written and cannot be disabled?
o: Data Access audit logs for Cloud Storage
questions.e: Data Access logs (except BigQuery) are disabled by default and must be enabled.

questions.q: Security wants to know who READ objects in a sensitive bucket. What must be enabled?
o: Data Access audit logs for Cloud Storage
Admin Activity logs, which already include reads
questions.e: Reads of data are Data Access operations, which are off by default for most services.

questions.q: Logs must be analyzed with SQL directly in Cloud Logging without exporting them. Which feature fits?
o: Log Analytics on an upgraded log bucket
questions.e: Log Analytics lets you query logs with SQL.

questions.q: A microservices application has slow requests and you need to find which service adds latency. Which tool is designed for this?
questions.e: Cloud Trace collects latency data for distributed requests.

questions.q: Which tool shows CPU and memory usage per function in production code with low overhead?
questions.e: Cloud Profiler samples resource consumption by code location.

questions.q: You want automatic suggestions to delete idle VMs and right-size over-provisioned ones. Where do you find them?
questions.e: Recommender analyzes usage and suggests optimizations.

questions.q: A workload needs Prometheus-format metrics from GKE collected without running your own Prometheus storage. What fits?
o: Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus
questions.e: Managed Service for Prometheus collects and stores Prometheus metrics at scale.

questions.q: Following least privilege, a developer only needs to start and stop VMs in one project. What should you grant?
o: A predefined or custom role with only the needed permissions, on that project
questions.e: Basic roles (Owner, Editor, Viewer) are very broad; prefer predefined or custom roles at the narrowest scope.

questions.q: No predefined role matches exactly the permissions required by an auditor. What can you do?
o: Create a custom role with the specific permissions at the organization or project level
questions.e: Predefined roles cannot be modified; custom roles can.

questions.q: An application on Compute Engine must write to a Cloud Storage bucket. What is the recommended way to give it credentials?
o: Attach a user-managed service account with the minimum role on the bucket to the VM
Store a user's password in the code
Download a service account key and copy it to the VM
Use the default service account with the Editor role
questions.e: Attached service accounts provide automatic, short-lived credentials via the metadata server.

questions.q: To attach a service account to a new VM, what permission does the user creating the VM need in addition to compute permissions?
o: Service Account User (roles/iam.serviceAccountUser) on that service account
questions.e: Using a service account as an identity for a resource requires actAs permission.

questions.q: An administrator wants to test commands with the permissions of a service account without downloading keys. What should they use?
o: Service account impersonation, for example the --impersonate-service-account flag, with roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
Log in as the service account in the console
questions.e: Impersonation creates short-lived credentials.

questions.q: A GitHub Actions pipeline must deploy to Google Cloud. Security forbids long-lived service account keys. What is the recommended approach?
o: Workload Identity Federation with GitHub as an OIDC identity provider
Store a service account key in a GitHub secret
questions.e: Workload Identity Federation exchanges external tokens for short-lived Google credentials.

questions.q: Pods in GKE must call Google Cloud APIs with their own identity and without keys. What should you configure?
questions.e: Workload Identity lets Kubernetes service accounts act as IAM principals.

questions.q: Security wants to block the creation of service account keys across the whole organization. What should they use?
o: The organization policy constraint that disables service account key creation
questions.e: Org policy constraints can prevent key creation organization-wide.

questions.q: Which statements about the default Compute Engine service account are correct?
o: It can have very broad permissions in many projects, so a dedicated user-managed service account is recommended
Best practice is to grant it only the roles the workload needs, or not use it
It cannot be used by any VM
It is shared across all customers of Google Cloud
questions.e: Historically the default service account received the Editor role; follow least privilege.

questions.q: Database passwords used by a Cloud Run service must not be stored in the image or in plain environment files. Where should you store them?
o: Secret Manager, exposed to the service as a secret environment variable or volume
questions.e: Secret Manager stores, versions, and controls access to secrets.

questions.q: A regulator requires that you control the encryption keys of data in Cloud Storage and can rotate or disable them. What should you use?
o: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) in Cloud KMS
questions.e: CMEK lets you manage keys in Cloud KMS.

questions.q: Which roles exist at the bucket level and grant progressively more control over objects?
o: Storage Object Viewer, Storage Object Creator, Storage Object Admin
questions.e: Predefined Cloud Storage roles let you grant only object read, create, or full control.

questions.q: A bucket must never become public, even if someone grants allUsers by mistake. What should you enforce?
o: Public access prevention on the bucket or via organization policy
questions.e: Public access prevention blocks public ACLs and IAM bindings.

questions.q: Security wants consistent IAM-only access control on a bucket, without object ACLs. What should be enabled?
questions.e: Uniform bucket-level access disables ACLs and uses only IAM.

questions.q: Which command grants the BigQuery Data Viewer role to a group on a project?
o: gcloud iam roles grant bigquery.dataViewer analysts@example.com
questions.e: add-iam-policy-binding adds a member-role binding to the resource's allow policy.

questions.q: An auditor needs to see all resources and their configuration in a project but must not change anything. Which basic or predefined role is the simplest fit?
o: Viewer (or a more specific viewer role, such as Security Reviewer, for IAM policies)
questions.e: Viewer gives read-only access; prefer more specific roles if possible.

questions.q: You must give a contractor temporary access that expires automatically at the end of the month. What feature helps?
o: An IAM condition with a date/time expression on the role binding
A label with the expiration date
questions.e: IAM Conditions allow time-based access.

questions.q: Sensitive data in BigQuery and Cloud Storage must not be copied to projects outside a defined perimeter, even by users with valid credentials. What fits?
questions.e: VPC Service Controls create perimeters around Google-managed services to reduce data exfiltration risk.

questions.q: Which service gives a central view of misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and threats across the organization?
questions.e: Security Command Center is Google Cloud's security and risk management platform.

questions.q: A web application must be protected against DDoS and common web attacks such as SQL injection, at the load balancer. What should you configure?
o: Google Cloud Armor security policies on the backend service
questions.e: Cloud Armor provides WAF rules and DDoS protection for external load balancers.

questions.q: An internal web application must be reachable only by authenticated employees, without a VPN. What should you use?
o: Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) in front of the application
A public load balancer without authentication
questions.e: IAP checks identity and context before granting access to applications.

questions.q: Which statements about service account keys are correct?
o: They are long-lived credentials that, if leaked, can be used by anyone until revoked
Alternatives such as attached service accounts, impersonation, and Workload Identity Federation are preferred
Keys can only be used inside Google Cloud
Keys are required for Cloud Shell
questions.e: Avoid keys whenever possible; if used, manage and rotate them carefully.
